Beginner.learningGoal: Replace if/else chains and casts with switch expressions, type patterns and relational patterns.
gotchas: A switch expression without a discard arm throws SwitchExpressionException for unhandled input
Order of arms matters: a broad pattern before a specific one hides it
shapeHints: mapping HTTP status codes to user messages

Intermediate.learningGoal: Use property, positional and list patterns to deconstruct data.
gotchas: List patterns with slices (..) and how they match empty lists
goodSolutionShows: Nested property patterns instead of null-checked chains
shapeHints: routing deep links by path segments

Advanced.learningGoal: Model a closed set of cases (discriminated-union style) with records and exhaustive switches.
gotchas: The compiler can't prove exhaustiveness over an open hierarchy
Adding a new case silently falls into a discard arm
goodSolutionShows: Sealed record hierarchy with a private base constructor
Switch without a catch-all discard where possible
Behaviour expressed as pure functions over the cases
shapeHints: a state machine for a sync job
